guṇi:
1guṇi(n)
m (fn). [S. guṇin], (gr.t.t.) what possesses qualities or attributes, a noun; a substantive; Sadd 79,.20 (guṇivācakaṃ padhānapadaṃ); 759,.26 (yathā hi bahubbīhisaddo ~ini ṭhito, tathā sakalo pāyaṃ samāso ~ini ṭhito).

2guṇi(n)
mfn. [cf S. guṇin], (according to ct) wearing a string (of flowers or jewels); (perhaps: having good qualities;? or to guni(n)3 qv?) Ja VI 153,1* (ime te pi mayhaṃ puttā ~ino kāyūradhārino rāja, of children; 153,10´ : ~ino ti mālāguṇa-ābharaṇehi samannāgatā).

3guṇi(n)
(or guṇi ?), m. [cf S. lex. guṇin, “furnished with a string, a bow”], (according to ct) armour, mail; but perhaps: a bow;? Ja VI 449,1* (āvudhabalavantānaṃ guṇikāyūradhārinaṃ … yodhānaṃ; 449,27´ : ~ī vuccati kavacaṃ, kavacāni c’ eva kāyūrābharaṇāni ca dhārentānaṃ, kavacasaṅkhātāni vā kāyūrāni dhārentānaṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~i); — see also guni(n)2.

[thera + ika, iya], of the elders; belonging to the elders; Thī p. 174,.17 (samattā theriyā gāthāyo, Ee so; Se theriyā gāthāyo samattā; Be samattā therīgāthāyo; Ce therīgāthā samattā); Vism 711,23* (vibhajjavādiseṭṭhānaṃ theriyānaṃ yasassinaṃ mahāvihāravāsīnaṃ); Sp 30,14* (ayaṃ paṭhama-mahāsaṅgīti nāma yā loke … thereh’ eva katattā ca therikā ti pavuccatī ti) = Sv 25,23*; Mhv 3:40 (thereh’ eva katattā ca theriyāyaṃ paraṃparā); 5:1 (yā Mahākassapādīhi mahātherehi ādito katā saddhammasaṅgīti theriyā ti pavuccati); 38:45 (aṭṭhārasa vihāre ca theriyānaṃ akārayi).
